name: XPS 倒序结合能分峰堆叠 (XPS Reverse-Axis Deconvolution)
when: Core-level XPS spectra (e.g. Cu 2p) plotted on a reverse Binding Energy (eV) axis with stacked samples, experimental envelope, fitted sum, Shirley/linear background, and shaded oxidation-state / satellite component peaks.

required_slots.x: Binding Energy (eV), reverse axis (high -> low, e.g. [970, 926] eV).
required_slots.components: Fitted component peaks (e.g. Cu+, Cu2+, satellite peaks) + Background.

optional_slots.sample_groups: 3 stacked samples (e.g. Catalyst-A, Catalyst-B, Catalyst-C) in seamless or shared-x stacked layout.
optional_slots.peak_labels: Oxidation state / orbital labels (Cu+, Cu2+, Sat., Cu 2p3/2, Cu 2p1/2).

constraints: Reverse Binding Energy x-axis (high eV on left, low eV on right) MUST be preserved.
If using raw .VGD files: VGData stream stores float64 raw COUNTS (not float32, not cps). Convert via cps = counts / (0.05 s * scans) or use exported Counts/s in xps_deconv.xlsx.
FigS8 original PDF is large format (8.49 x 7.46 in, 611x537 pt) with bold scaled fonts (36pt labels, 26pt ticks, 3.96pt frames) — match 1:1 visual weight!

notes: In xps_deconv.xlsx, 3 sample blocks sit side-by-side in 23 columns (cols 0-6 Catalyst-C, cols 8-14 Catalyst-B, cols 16-22 Catalyst-A) with NaN separator columns (7, 15).
Note Avantage .vgp files cannot be opened without Avantage; all component curves and Table S3 ratios are already exported in data/xps/.
Fill components from local Background baseline (not y=0) so shaded peaks sit cleanly on the Shirley background!
